survey: Watch the full video. Mark gameplay, non-game footage and end cards. Choose as few segments as possible, up to 30 seconds each, with cuts near movement starts or camera changes. List scenes, characters, objects and their first clear appearances.
frames: Choose the fewest clear frames covering this segment's scenes, characters, objects and ground, especially newly appearing items, and select existing generated references for content already seen. When inspecting a converted image, return ok=false and describe the discrepancy if any logo or text (including numbers, brand marks, warnings and HUD labels) differs from the source in content, lettering, font, color, shape, size, placement or appearance, even when material coverage is complete. Blur, occlusion or overlap already in the source is not a defect. Write findings in English ASCII without reproducing non-English source lettering.
image: Convert Image 1 to realistic materials, but keep all logos, text, numbers and HUD labels unchanged and exclude them from material conversion.
video: Edit the video: replace its materials to match the reference images.
segment: Compare the result with the source at normal playback speed, not paused or magnified frames. Report missed realistic materials, content changes, motion changes or artifacts only when readily noticeable in motion or when they materially change the main content or action. Subtle defects, brief minor clipping and small shape or texture inconsistencies are tolerated. UI, HUD and text are relaxed: accept mild blur, ghosting or jelly-like deformation while they change, if they look normal when static and stay in place; report them only for obvious drift, severe distortion, persistent static defects or major missing or added elements. Ignore issues already in the source. Tolerated imperfections are not issues: if nothing else is wrong, return pass with an empty issues list.
tail: Compare Image 1 (the previous generated segment last frame) with Image 2 (the next source segment first frame). Decide only whether these are consecutive views of the same continuous shot. Ignore differences in material realism, texture quality, lighting style and rendering style. Return ok=true for the same continuous shot, otherwise false. List inventory IDs visible in Image 1 without judging materials.
